commitResults.messageTitle: Rename Duke to LeBron and implement greet/exit behavior
commitResults.messageBody:
Renames the chatbot from Duke to LeBron across the entry-point class
and docs, replaces the old figlet banner with a LeBron block-letter
banner, and updates main() to print a divider-wrapped greeting on
startup followed by a farewell message before exiting.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Fill in student profile in AGENTS.md
commitResults.messageBody:
Records the student's prior programming experience and IDE familiarity
so future assistance is tailored appropriately, and fixes a stray typo
in the top-level heading.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Echo user input and exit on "bye"
commitResults.messageBody:
Adds a read loop that echoes each entered line back to the user,
terminating when the input is "bye", per the required chatbot
command-loop behavior.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Store and list user-entered items
commitResults.messageBody:
Adds a fixed-size String[100] array to remember each item the user
enters, printing "added: ..." on entry and a numbered listing on the
"list" command, per the Level-2 spec (in-memory only, no persistence).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Add Task class to represent an item with done/not-done status
commitResults.messageBody:
Introduces a Task object bundling a description with an isDone flag,
plus mark()/unmark() and a toString() that renders as "[X] desc" or
"[ ] desc". This replaces the plan of using a parallel boolean array
alongside the existing String[] items, since keeping description and
status together on one object is simpler to reason about and extends
naturally to future task types (todo/deadline/event).

Not yet wired into LeBron.java; that follows in the next commit.

commitResults.messageTitle: Store tasks as Task objects instead of raw strings
commitResults.messageBody:
Swaps the Task[] array in for the old String[] items array so each
stored entry carries its own done/not-done status via Task, not just
its text. addItem() now wraps input in new Task(...); printList()
relies on Task.toString() to render the "[ ] desc" / "[X] desc" line.
List/add behaviour and output are otherwise unchanged.

commitResults.messageTitle: Parse "mark <n>" and "unmark <n>" commands
commitResults.messageBody:
Adds handling in processCommands() for two new command forms, each
followed by the 1-based index shown by "list". markTask() converts to
a 0-based array index, flips the task's done status via Task.mark()/
unmark(), and echoes the updated task back to the user.

Indices are trusted as valid for now (no bounds/parse-error handling
yet) — that's the next step.

commitResults.messageTitle: Handle invalid task numbers in mark/unmark without crashing
commitResults.messageBody:
markTask() previously trusted its index argument, so a non-numeric
value threw NumberFormatException and an out-of-range value threw
ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException, both of which would have terminated
the program. Now both cases are caught and reported as a normal
chatbot message, and the valid path is unchanged.

commitResults.messageTitle: Make Task abstract and add Todo task type
commitResults.messageBody:
Task now delegates its type icon ([T]/[D]/[E]) to subclasses via an
abstract getTypeIcon() method, laying the groundwork for Deadline and
Event. Todo is the first concrete subclass; the free-text fallback in
LeBron now constructs a Todo instead of a bare Task.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add Deadline task type and deadline command
commitResults.messageBody:
Parses "deadline <description> /by <date>", rejecting the command with
a friendly message if the description or the /by date is missing.
addItem is folded into a new storeTask(Task) so both the free-text
fallback and the parsed deadline task share one storage path, and the
acknowledgement now prints the task's full decorated form.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add Event task type and event command
commitResults.messageBody:
Parses "event <description> /from <start> /to <end>", rejecting the
command with a friendly message if the description, /from, or /to
part is missing. The /to marker is searched for only after /from so a
missing /from isn't masked by a coincidental match further in the
text.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add explicit todo command and reject unrecognized commands
commitResults.messageBody:
Free text is no longer silently stored as a to-do; it must now start
with "todo ". Anything that isn't list/mark/unmark/bye/todo/deadline/
event is rejected with an error instead of being treated as a task,
consistent with the new typed-command interface.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add LeBronException for user-input errors
commitResults.messageBody:
Introduces a single checked exception type to carry LeBron-flavored,
user-facing error messages, replacing the print-and-return-null
pattern currently duplicated across the parse/mark methods.

commitResults.messageTitle: Throw LeBronException from todo/deadline/event parsing
commitResults.messageBody:
parseTodo/parseDeadline/parseEvent now throw LeBronException with
LeBron-flavored messages instead of printing and returning null.
processCommands catches the exception at each of these three call
sites for now; this will be consolidated into a single catch once
markTask is converted too.

commitResults.messageTitle: Throw LeBronException from markTask instead of printing inline
commitResults.messageBody:
Replaces the NumberFormatException catch and the out-of-range if
check with LeBronException throws, matching the pattern used by the
parse methods. Call sites in processCommands each catch it for now;
consolidation into a single catch comes next.

commitResults.messageTitle: Simplify storeTask now that parsing can't return null
commitResults.messageBody:
The parse methods throw LeBronException instead of returning null on
failure, so storeTask can no longer be called with a null task; the
now-unreachable guard is removed.

commitResults.messageTitle: Centralize error printing in processCommands
commitResults.messageBody:
Wraps the whole command dispatch in a single try/catch(LeBronException),
replacing the per-branch catches added in the previous two commits.
The unrecognized-command branch now throws LeBronException instead of
printing directly, so all user-input errors flow through one place.

commitResults.messageTitle: Switch task storage from array to ArrayList
commitResults.messageBody:
The fixed-size Task[] + itemCount pair required manual bookkeeping
(capacity, index tracking) and would need array-shifting logic to
support removing tasks. Swapping to List<Task> backed by an
ArrayList lets storeTask, printList, and markTask rely on the
Collections API's size()/get()/add() instead, and clears the way
for a delete command that can just call List.remove(index).

commitResults.messageTitle: Add support for deleting tasks from the list
commitResults.messageBody:
Adds a "delete <n>" command that removes the given 1-based task and
prints a confirmation, mirroring markTask's parsing/validation
pattern (LeBronException on a non-numeric or out-of-range index).
Relies on List.remove(index) from the ArrayList-backed storage
introduced in the previous commit rather than manual shifting.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add description and done-status getters to Task
commitResults.messageBody:
Storage will need to read a task's description and done flag to
serialize it, and neither was previously exposed outside the class.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add getBy getter to Deadline
commitResults.messageBody: Needed by Storage to serialize a deadline's date/time field to disk.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add getFrom and getTo getters to Event
commitResults.messageBody: Needed by Storage to serialize an event's start/end fields to disk.

commitResults.messageTitle: Broaden LeBronException's Javadoc to cover internal warnings
commitResults.messageBody:
Storage reuses this exception internally to signal a malformed line in
the save file, caught locally and never shown in LeBron's chat voice.
The old wording promised the message was always safe to print
"directly to the user," which no longer held for that usage.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add Storage class for reading/writing tasks to disk
commitResults.messageBody:
Introduces load()/save() against a hard-coded relative path
(./data/lebron.txt, built via java.nio.file.Path so it stays
OS-independent) using a simple pipe-delimited text format, since the
project has no build tool and thus no JSON library available.

A missing file or missing data/ folder is treated as an empty task
list rather than an error (both share the same Files.exists check);
the folder is created on first save. Lines that fail to parse are
skipped with a warning instead of aborting the whole load, so one
corrupted line doesn't cost the user their entire task list. Not yet
wired into LeBron.

commitResults.messageTitle: Load tasks on startup and save on every list change
commitResults.messageBody:
Wires Storage into LeBron: main() now loads the saved task list before
greeting the user, and storeTask/markTask/deleteTask each persist the
updated list immediately after mutating it, so the task list survives
across restarts.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch-Level-7 into master
commitResults.messageBody:
Adds automatic save/load of the task list to ./data/lebron.txt,
handling a missing file/folder gracefully on first run.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add TaskDateTime for parsing and formatting deadline/event dates
commitResults.messageBody:
Deadline.by and Event.from/to are currently raw Strings, printed back
exactly as typed. This standalone value class will let those fields
hold real java.time values instead: it accepts user input like
2/12/2019 or 2/12/2019 1800 (date, optionally with a 24h time),
serializes to a stable ISO form for the save file, and formats for
display as e.g. "Dec 02 2019, 6:00pm". Not yet wired into Deadline,
Event, LeBron, or Storage - that follows in subsequent commits.

commitResults.messageTitle: Parse and store deadline dates with TaskDateTime instead of String
commitResults.messageBody:
Deadline.by now holds a TaskDateTime rather than raw text, so
"deadline return book /by 2/12/2019 1800" is understood as an actual
date/time (2nd Dec 2019, 6pm) instead of an opaque string. LeBron's
parseDeadline rejects unparseable dates via TaskDateTime.parseInput
before a Deadline is even constructed, and Storage round-trips the
value through TaskDateTime's stable ISO storage format so the save
file stays independent of whatever format the user typed.

commitResults.messageTitle: Parse and store event dates with TaskDateTime instead of String
commitResults.messageBody:
Same treatment as the previous Deadline commit, applied to Event's
from/to fields: "event ... /from 6/8/2019 1400 /to 6/8/2019 1600" is
now understood as real dates/times rather than opaque strings.
parseEvent rejects unparseable /from or /to values before an Event is
constructed, and Storage round-trips both fields through
TaskDateTime's stable ISO storage format.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch-Level-8 into master
Add TaskList to hold task-list operations
commitResults.messageBody:
Extracts the in-memory task collection (add/get/mark/unmark/delete,
plus centralized bounds-checking) out of LeBron into its own class, as
a first step of splitting LeBron's mixed responsibilities into
dedicated Ui/Storage/Parser/TaskList classes. LeBron and Storage still
use their own static list handling for now; later steps will wire
TaskList in.

commitResults.messageTitle: Convert Storage from a static utility to an instance class
commitResults.messageBody:
Storage now takes its file path in its constructor (defaulting to
data/lebron.txt) instead of hardcoding it as a static field, so it can
be constructed and owned like Ui and TaskList will be. Load/save logic
is unchanged. LeBron is updated to construct a single Storage instance
and call load()/save() on it; this is a minimal update to keep LeBron
compiling, and will be superseded when LeBron is rewritten as a thin
orchestrator in a later step.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add Ui and route all console I/O through it
commitResults.messageBody:
Extracts the greeting/farewell text, banner, divider, task-list
printing, and all confirmation/error messages out of LeBron into a
new Ui class, along with the Scanner-based command reading (readCommand()
returns null at EOF so LeBron's loop can just check for null).

LeBron still holds the task list and command-dispatch logic itself for
now; that moves to TaskList/Parser in the next steps.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add Parser to interpret and execute commands
commitResults.messageBody:
Moves the command-dispatch if/else chain and the todo/deadline/event/
index parsing logic out of LeBron into a new Parser class. Parser.execute
takes the raw input line plus the TaskList/Ui/Storage to act on, so it
both interprets a command and carries it out (mutate, confirm, save) in
one call. LeBron isn't wired to use this yet; that happens in the next
step when LeBron is rewritten as a thin orchestrator.

commitResults.messageTitle: Rewrite LeBron as a thin orchestrator
commitResults.messageBody:
LeBron.main now just constructs Ui, Storage, TaskList, and delegates
each input line to Parser.execute, catching LeBronException and
printing it via Ui. This completes the extraction: LeBron no longer
holds task-list state or command-parsing logic directly — that now
lives in TaskList and Parser respectively, with all printing/input
going through Ui and all persistence through Storage.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch-A-MoreOOP into master
Organize classes into packages by responsibility
commitResults.messageBody:
Splits the previously flat src/main/java into lebron (entry point),
lebron.task (Task and its subclasses, TaskList, TaskDateTime),
lebron.parser, lebron.storage, lebron.ui, and lebron.exception, so the
package layout mirrors how these classes already collaborate and stays
easy to navigate as the project grows.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch-A-Packages into master
Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/add-gradle-support'
Test TaskDateTime: parsing, formatting, and error paths
commitResults.messageBody:
Covers both parseInput/parseStorage entry points, the two supported
formats each accepts, and their LeBronException paths on invalid
input, plus the hasTime branching in toStorageString()/toString()
(including AM/PM lowercasing). Done first since Deadline/Event's
toString() embeds this class's formatting, so later commits can
build expected strings against already-verified behavior.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Test Todo, Deadline, and Event
commitResults.messageBody:
Covers mark()/unmark() toggling isDone(), getStatusIcon() in both
states, each subclass's getTypeIcon(), and toString() formatting
(including the " (by: ...)" and " (from: ... to: ...)" suffixes),
built on TaskDateTime's already-verified toString(). Task itself is
abstract, so its behavior is exercised through these subclasses
rather than a standalone TaskTest.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Test TaskList
commitResults.messageBody:
Covers add/get/mark/unmark/delete on valid 0-based indices, the
out-of-range checks shared via checkIndex() (negative, ==size,
empty-list), that delete() shifts later entries down, the defensive
copy in the List-arg constructor, and that getAll() rejects mutation.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Test Storage
commitResults.messageBody:
Uses @TempDir with the Storage(Path) constructor so no test ever
touches the real data/lebron.txt. Covers load() on a missing file,
a save()/load() round trip across Todo/Deadline/Event (including
done flags), that save() creates missing parent directories, and
that load() skips malformed lines (unknown type icon, bad done-flag,
missing date field) rather than aborting the whole load. Deliberately
not exercising the IOException branches in load()/save(), since
permission-based failures are unreliable to trigger portably.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Test Ui
commitResults.messageBody:
Captures System.out into a ByteArrayOutputStream (restored in
@AfterEach) to assert on every show* method's printed text, including
1-based numbering in showTaskList() for both empty and non-empty
lists. For readCommand(), System.in is redirected to a
ByteArrayInputStream before constructing the Ui under test, since its
Scanner field binds to System.in at construction time; verifies
sequential lines are returned in order and null at end of input.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Test Parser
commitResults.messageBody:
Uses real TaskList/Ui/Storage(tempDir) collaborators (no mocking
library in build.gradle) with stdout redirected but not asserted on,
since Ui's own formatting is UiTest's responsibility. Covers each
command's happy path (todo/deadline/event/mark/unmark/delete/list)
and error paths (missing description, missing /by or /from //to,
empty date text, invalid date text, non-numeric or out-of-range
index, unrecognized command), plus a spot-check that a mutation is
actually persisted by reloading a second Storage on the same path.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch-A-JUnit into master
Fix mainClass and jar filename for the A-Jar increment
commitResults.messageBody:
application.mainClass still pointed at the template's seedu.duke.Duke,
which doesn't exist in this project, so `./gradlew run` and the
shadowJar task's runnable manifest (Main-Class) were both broken.
Point it at the real entry point, lebron.LeBron, and rename the
shadowJar output from the leftover duke.jar to lebron.jar so the
distributed JAR is runnable via `java -jar lebron.jar` and named
after the actual app.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add Javadoc to constructors and key methods
commitResults.messageBody:
Documents the purpose of each task type's constructor, the type-icon
and toString overrides, and a couple of previously-undocumented
helpers (Storage#parseDoneFlag, LeBronException's constructor), so
that classes without existing doc comments become self-explanatory
without needing to read the implementation.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Add seedu-java-coding-standard skill
commitResults.messageBody:
The project had no documented Java coding standard, so style was
inconsistent and undocumented across increments.

Add a project skill summarizing the SE-EDU intermediate Java
convention (naming, layout, statements, comments/Javadoc) and
reference it from AGENTS.md so it is mandatory for all future Java
code, not just something to apply ad hoc.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Add seedu-git-standard skill
commitResults.messageBody:
Commit messages so far have had no documented format to follow,
leading to inconsistent subject lines and bodies across the project
history.

Add a project skill summarizing the SE-EDU Git conventions (subject
line, body, branch naming) and reference it from AGENTS.md so it is
mandatory for all future commits, mirroring how the Java coding
standard was just wired up.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Fix Java coding standard violations
commitResults.messageBody:
The codebase had no documented Java standard until now (see the
seedu-java-coding-standard skill), and a few pre-existing spots
didn't match it: Ui's banner field used camelCase instead of the
SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE required for static final constants, and the
constructors on LeBron.main, LeBronException, Task, Deadline, Event,
and Todo were public but had no header comment.

Rename the field to BANNER and add a one-line Javadoc comment to
each constructor, so the code now matches the standard the project
is committing to enforce going forward.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Add find command to search tasks by keyword
commitResults.messageBody:
Users could previously only browse the full task list to locate a
task, which becomes tedious as the list grows.

Add a "find <keyword>" command that lists tasks whose description
contains the given keyword. TaskList.find() does a case-insensitive
substring match and returns matches in entry order; Ui.showMatchingTasks()
prints them under a "Here are the matching tasks in your list:" header,
reusing the existing numbered-list rendering; Parser wires up the new
command and rejects a missing/blank keyword, consistent with how the
other commands validate their arguments.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch-A-JavaDoc into master
commitResults.messageBody:
Adds Javadoc comments to constructors and key methods across LeBron,
LeBronException, Storage, Deadline, Event, Task, TaskList, Todo, and Ui.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch-A-CodingStandard into master
commitResults.messageBody:
Fixes Java coding standard violations (renames banner -> BANNER,
adds missing Javadoc, etc.) and adds seedu-git-standard and
seedu-java-coding-standard skills.

Resolved a conflict in LeBron.java where both this branch and the
already-merged branch-A-JavaDoc independently added Javadoc to
main(); kept the more detailed version from branch-A-JavaDoc.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch-Level-9 into master
commitResults.messageBody:
Adds the find command to search tasks by keyword, with Parser, TaskList,
and Ui support plus unit tests.
